jobs.title: Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting
jobs.description: Career Category Strategy and Innovation Job Description Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting What you will do The Digital Product Manager, Product Operations - Measurement & Reporting will help Amgen measure, understand, and improve adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) by supporting the measurement, analysis, and reporting capabilities used to assess product management maturity, team health, and quality of core product practices and artifacts. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Management - Product Operations, this individual contributor role will independently own defined measurement and reporting capabilities within the broader Product Operations strategy. The Digital Product Manager will work with Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, digital product teams, analytics and technology partners to maintain meaningful measures, improve dashboards and reporting, conduct product maturity assessments, and translate quantitative and qualitative data into actionable insights. This role will help distinguish activity and compliance measures from meaningful indicators of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact. The Digital Product Manager will use data, stakeholder feedback, and learning from product teams to improve measurement approaches over time and help the Product Management Hub identify where teams are progressing, where barriers remain, and where additional support or enablement may be needed. Responsibilities DPOM Measurement and Metrics • Manage and improve defined measures for DPOM adoption, product management maturity, team health, product artifact quality, and related Product Management Hub priorities. • Apply established measurement frameworks and maturity dimensions across product teams, product groups, and business functions. • Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to evaluate whether measures provide meaningful signals of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact rather than simply tracking activity or completion. • Identify gaps in metrics, data, instrumentation, or measurement approaches and recommend practical improvements. • Define and document data, instrumentation, and KPI requirements for assigned measurement capabilities in partnership with analytics, technology, and reporting teams. Dashboards, Reporting, and Insights • Build, maintain , and improve dashboards, scorecards, reports, and related measurement tools directly and/or in partnership with analytics, technology, and reporting teams. • Gather, organize, analyze, and interpret DPOM-related data using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Jira Align, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ChatGPT, or similar tools. • Prepare recurring reporting and analyses that support MBRs, QBRs, Product Management Hub reviews, and other operating rhythms. • Translate data, trends, qualitative feedback, and product-team observations into clear findings, risks, and recommendations. • Monitor data quality, reporting consistency, and usability of measurement outputs and work with appropriate partners to resolve issues. Product Management Maturity and Artifact Quality • Conduct and support product management maturity assessments using established DPOM frameworks and assessment approaches. • Evaluate product management practices and artifacts such as roadmaps, OKRs, product charters, product strategies, discovery practices, prioritization approaches, and value measures. • Identify recurring maturity gaps, adoption barriers, product management anti-patterns, and areas where teams may need additional guidance or support. • Partner with Product Management Catalysts to incorporate field-based insights and observations from product-team engagements. • Synthesize assessment findings so they can inform Product Operations priorities, playbook improvements, training, accelerator workshops, coaching, and other enablement activities. Reporting Operations and Continuous Improvement • Support integration of DPOM measurement and reporting into established Product Management Hub and enterprise operating rhythms. • Independently manage assigned reporting processes, analyses, or measurement capabilities and continuously improve their quality, usefulness, and efficiency. • Partner with Product Operations colleagues to connect measurement insights with improvements to DPOM standards, playbooks, tools, training, and adoption approaches. • Gather feedback from product teams, leaders, and reporting users to identify opportunities to improve measurement methods, dashboards, reporting experiences, and decision support. • Identify appropriate opportunities to use AI, automation, and reusable workflows to improve data analysis, artifact assessment, reporting, and insight generation. Cross-Functional Partnership and Product Community Contribution • Build trusted relationships with Product Operations, Product Management Catalysts, Digital Product Managers, technology leaders, business partners, analytics and reporting teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders. • Influence product-team partners and leaders through clear communication, preparation, data, and evidence-based recommendations. • Facilitate productive discussions about measurement findings, maturity gaps, reporting needs, data limitations, and improvement opportunities. • Partner with data, analytics, technology, privacy, security, regulatory, and governance specialists when measurement or reporting needs require additional expertise. • Share reusable insights, examples, and feedback that help improve DPOM measurement practices and strengthen the broader product management community. What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Digital Product Manager, Product Operations we seek is a product-minded, analytical problem solver who can independently manage defined measurement and reporting capabilities and turn evidence into practical improvements. Basic Qualifications • 3+ years of experience in Digital Product, Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Operations, Product Analytics, Business Reporting, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or comparable customer- and outcome-focused work. • Demonstrated ownership of a defined product area, capability, or comparable problem space, including the ability to make independent decisions within an established strategy and lead cross-functional delivery and iteration. Preferred Qualifications • Experience in product operations, digital product management, product analytics, business reporting, measurement, digital transformation, or related disciplines. • Experience defining, maintaining , or improving adoption, maturity, performance, effectiveness, or quality measures for product teams, operating models, or transformation efforts. • Understanding of product management practices including product strategy, roadmaps, OKRs, product charters, discovery, prioritization, user and business problem definition, and value measurement. • Experience building or maintaining dashboards, scorecards, reporting mechanisms, or recurring business reporting using Power BI, Tableau, Jira Align, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ChatGPT, or similar platforms. • Ability to combine quantitative data, qualitative feedback, and stakeholder perspectives into clear findings and actionable recommendations. • Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to distinguish activity or compliance metrics from meaningful indicators of adoption, maturity, quality, and impact. • Experience defining data, instrumentation, and KPI needs and partnering with analytics or technology specialists to improve measurement capabilities. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data, findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional audiences. • Ability to work independently within an established strategy, manage assigned priorities, navigate ambiguity, and adapt approaches based on evidence and outcomes. • Experience partnering across product, technology, business, analytics, reporting, or enablement teams in a complex enterprise environment. • Experience in healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries preferred; candidates from high-tech, digital, consulting, or product-led organizations are also encouraged to apply. • Familiarity with AI-native workflows, generative AI, responsible AI principles, and opportunities to use AI and automation to improve product measurement, analysis, and reporting preferred. .

jobs.title: Engineering Maintenance Technician
jobs.description: Job Description Why Patients Need You Whether you are involved in the design and development of manufacturing processes for products or supporting maintenance and reliability, engineering is vital to making sure customers and patients have the medicines they need, when they need them. Working with our innovative engineering team, you'll help bring medicines to the world even faster by imagining what’s possible and taking action. What You Will Achieve Working with Pfizer’s dynamic engineering team, you will play a critical part in managing the maintenance and reliability engineering activities involving the redesign, maintenance, and repair of utilities systems, buildings, and production/non-production equipment. As an Engineering Maintenance Technician, your knowledge and skills will contribute towards the goals and objectives of the team. Your ability to meet team targets will help in completing critical deliverables. Your innovative use of communication tools and techniques will facilitate in managing difficult issues and establishing consensus between teams. It is your hard work and focus that will make Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients across the globe. How You Will Achieve It Contribute to completion of projects, manage own time to meet agreed targets, develop plans for short-term work activities on own projects. Provide engineering support to develop scope of work, project execution plans, and associated engineering studies for equipment and component installation, modification etc. Provide necessary operational support as needed. Review preventive and corrective work order activities and provide equipment maintenance history review. Manage technical writing and document review. Ensure calibration compliance with (Current) Good Manufacturing Practices (part of GxP) contemporary technologies and best aseptic practices. Participate in equipment/system-based Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) investigations and update equipment reliability plans. Partner with Production and Quality Team Leads on troubleshooting and scheduling. Promote safety within the workplace by following site safety procedures and perform proactive safety assessments, foster a safe work culture. Facilitate and participate in the investigation teams created to determine root cause of exemption reports, QARs and laboratory investigation reports. Serve as a liaison between quality, Operations and regulatory/Compliance to facilitate timely closure of investigations. Assist in the development the Preventative Maintenance program. Engage with site sustaining Engineering Operations for input and best practice. Work with Engineering teams in building the Maintenance Management database system (EAMS) Qualifications Must-Have Diploma/Degree in an Engineering/Technical Discipline or Electrical/Mechanical Trade Qualification Minimum 3 years’ experience in an Engineering/Maintenance Technician role within a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing environment. jobs.description: At Datadog, Office Operations run the day-to-day operations for Datadog and help to keep our employees safe, happy and productive, which means every day is different. Office Operations work closely with leadership and employees to ensure that Datadog keeps scaling smoothly and remains a great place to work. As the Front Desk Associate at Datadog, you’ll be responsible for managing the front desk guest experience. You’ll assist with various vendor, event or product research efforts and will be a general go-to for the Denver Datadog office questions for both visitors and employees alike. We are looking for a high-energy, “get it done” person who wants to learn and grow with the company as we rapidly expand. cold_email.subject: Interest in Data Acquisition Lead- eConsent — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Data Acquisition Lead- eConsent opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Growth Lead, Japan
jobs.description: About the Team The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows. The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn country priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements. We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets. About the Role We’re looking for a growth lead in Japan to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with the Japan GM to understand local users, identify the biggest growth opportunities, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact. The role combines product growth and funnel optimization with performance marketing: connecting audience, message, creative, and channel learnings to better in-product journeys. You’ll be responsible for: - Partner with the Japan GM to set a country growth plan and roadmap priorities, with clear hypotheses, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes. - Use user research, funnel and cohort data, and competitive insight to find local friction and prioritize the opportunities that matter most to users. - Run performance marketing tests in collaboration with regional marketers across relevant channels, creators, and partners; use incrementality, CAC, payback, and LTV to decide what to scale. - Design and run rigorous experiments across onboarding, activation, repeat usage, re-engagement, and paid conversion; measure incremental impact and iterate. Work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Data Science partners to prototype, test, and ship locally relevant experiences. - Partner with regional Marketing and central media teams to brief and prioritize audience, positioning, creative, and channel tests based on the country plan. - Own the country growth scorecard across acquisition, retention, paid conversion, and unit economics, distinguishing incremental user and revenue gains and learnings Connect priority use cases, product improvements, and acquisition plans into a coherent journey from first exposure to repeated value. - Run the growth operating cadence with the GM and regional teams, aligning central and local partners on results, trade-offs, dependencies, and next steps. - Build and operate segmentation, lifecycle journeys, growth tooling, performance marketing and product experimentation capabilities that can be scaled across markets. We’re looking for someone with: - 10+ years of experience across product growth, growth marketing, data science, or growth strategy and operations, with hands-on execution in a fast-moving technology company. - A user-first track record of turning local research and behavior into product and growth priorities, then shipping improvements with measurable impact. - Strong command of acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization funnels, including technically rigorous experimentation and interpretation. - Practical performance marketing experience across audience, channel, creative, and measurement decisions, and the ability to partner effectively with media specialists. - Analytical fluency in cohort analysis and growth economics, including incrementality, LTV, CAC, payback, and contribution margin. - Experience adapting and running campaigns across markets, using local audience behavior, channels, language, and cultural context to improve relevance and performance at scale. - Experience owning growth goals and delivering measurable user or revenue outcomes across product and marketing levers. - The ability to influence and align central and regional teams, translate local needs into scalable approaches, and make progress through ambiguity. Workplace & Location - Tokyo, Japan - Travel as needed for key cross-functional sprints and regional collaboration.
